thread:
raja: Quick sync — planning v2.16.0 multi-region rollout next Thursday. Need to lock cutoffs, canary windows, and branch handoff. Draft below, please ack or propose edits.

jess: dates/times? timezone messy as usual :sweat_smile:

lucas: proposing canary -> US first, then EU, then APAC. Times in UTC so everyone can convert:
- US canary: Thu 22:00–22:30 UTC (late afternoon PT)
- EU ramp: Thu 23:00–01:00 UTC (overnight CET/CEST)
- APAC final: Fri 08:00–09:30 UTC (evening JST/AEST)

sophia: those windows look ok. Is branch freeze planned?

raja: yes — branch freeze: Wed 18:00 UTC. Changelogs + final QA by Wed 16:00 UTC. No merges after freeze except hotfix with approver tag.

tony: can we shorten EU window? ops team prefers <2h to avoid on-call overlap. Suggest EU 23:00–00:30 UTC.

lucas: ok with 90m. We can do staged traffic: 5%->25%->75% then 100% with 10m settle checks.

release-bot: Canary checks configured: p50 latency, request error rate, and model degradation heuristics. Alerts: p50 > 200ms for 5m OR errors > 0.5% for 3m -> paged to @eng-oncall.

sophia: reminder for dedicated customers: pinning guidance in the rollout notes. We should publish a short notice to customers 24h before.

raja: good catch. Ops to send customer notice Wed 21:00 UTC. Marketing will handle the release note headline.

jess: quick checklist for engineers:
```
- bump version in repo: package.json, helm/Chart.yaml, and infra/manifests
- tag: git tag -a v2.16.0 -m "release v2.16.0" && git push origin v2.16.0
- update changelog PR with final entries and QA signoff
- confirm canary healthchecks are green in staging before cutover
```

tony: also add rollout flags: config/feature_flags.yaml -> enable_new_routing: false by default, flip during canary.

lucas: FYI I ran a quick load test against canary variant — expect ~8% CPU increase on the 40k token seq case. Ops, please ensure autoscaler headroom >= 20% for canary.

release-bot: Autoscaler suggestion: reserve +2 GPUs in US pool and +1 GPU in EU pool for canary.

sophia: who owns the rollback? Need clear playbook in the thread.

raja: rollback owner: lucas (service), tony (infra). If canary fails, immediate revert to v2.15.2 tag and scale down new pool. Run rollback steps in playbook -> link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback

jess: can someone post the final UTC windows and freeze cutoffs in #calendar when locked? I'll pin them.

raja: will lock these windows EOD today if no objections:
- Branch freeze: Wed 18:00 UTC
- Changelog/QA cut: Wed 16:00 UTC
- Customer notice: Wed 21:00 UTC
- Canary (US): Thu 22:00–22:30 UTC
- EU ramp: Thu 23:00–00:30 UTC
- APAC final: Fri 08:00–09:30 UTC

sophia: acked. I'll coordinate customer notice with marketing.

lucas: ack. I'll prep the canary config and post PR for review this afternoon.

tony: ack. I'll provision the extra GPU headroom and verify autoscaler thresholds.

raja: thanks — locking if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Reminder queued: lock deadline EOD -> 1867050000 (epoch).
